name: qwen3.8-27b-obliterated
notes: Abliterated bf16 checkpoint from OBLITERATUS (18 root safetensors shards, ~55.7 GB). Only the root safetensors + metadata are mirrored to R2; the repo's GGUF quantizations and mlx-4bit/mlx-8bit variants are intentionally excluded (transfer with --exclude '*.gguf' --exclude 'mlx-4bit/*' --exclude 'mlx-8bit/*').
